head: split
notes: Size not found. NCRS snippet says it is a split lockwasher with plain finish; CorvetteForum AIM list names 0103320 but gives no size. Stacked NSN 5310-00-010-3320 is a Fruehauf part, unrelated. Pass 3 (2026-10-26): GMPartsGiant names it 'Washer, Hsl (Hardened)', discontinued, no size; camaros.com 1968 Camaro valance pad kit and a 67-69 Camaro catalog (lock washer, Y-block mounting) cite it without size; camaros.net list puts 0103320-P178 next to '3/8 Regular' label but the label belongs ambiguously, so not used; AMK search no hit. Pass 4 (Brave): Detroit Diesel (a GM division using GM standard part numbers) lists 103320 / MTU 00103320 as 'Lock Washer, 5/16 in'; the same DD numbering gives 103321 = 3/8 lock washer, matching the CorvetteForum AIM list label for 0103321. Size is from Detroit Diesel listings only, not a GM/Corvette source, hence low. Case IH 103320 (also 5/16 lock washer) is a different numbering system, not used.
